evidence.locator: text: complete three-paragraph license, especially the grant and its sole proviso (redistribution is conditioned only on retaining the stated material; no same-license, source-disclosure, or other reciprocal condition appears)

text: grant paragraph ('Redistribution and use of this document (ALGLIB Reference Manual) with or without modification, are permitted'); the grant is permissive but expressly document-specific rather than a software-license grant

text: grant paragraph proviso (redistributions must retain the copyright notice, condition, and disclaimer 'as the first (or last) lines of this file'; the mandatory placement makes the burden material)
text: grant paragraph proviso (redistributions must retain 'the above copyright notice, this condition and the following disclaimer' as the first or last lines of the file)
text: complete three-paragraph license (no patent grant, patent condition, or patent-termination clause is stated)

text: grant paragraph ('Redistribution and use of this document ... with or without modification, are permitted'); the unrestricted use grant permits commercial and private use as well as distribution and modification
text: final two paragraphs ('AS IS', disclaimer of express and implied warranties, and exclusion of direct, indirect, incidental, special, exemplary, and consequential damages)

metadata: id=ALGLIB-Documentation, name='ALGLIB Documentation License', deprecated=false, osi=true, fsf=false; text: the grant is limited to 'this document (ALGLIB Reference Manual)', so OSI approval does not make it a safe recommendation for the guide's software project forms and the vocabulary cannot represent the document-only subject losslessly
text: grant paragraph proviso ('provided that such redistributions will retain'); redistribution activates the retention and placement duties, while modification alone does not
